name: create release

on:
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: write

jobs:
  build:
    uses: ./.github/workflows/build.yml

  release:
    needs: build
    runs-on: ubuntu-22.04
    steps:
      # full history: the build number is the commit count
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Compute build number
        id: version
        run: |
          echo "version=$(grep -m1 '^version' Cargo.toml | cut -d'"' -f2)" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          echo "build=b$(git rev-list --count HEAD)" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"

      - uses: actions/download-artifact@v4
        with:
          path: artifacts
          merge-multiple: true

      - name: Create release
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
        run: |
          gh release create "${{ steps.version.outputs.build }}" artifacts/* \
            --repo "${{ github.repository }}" \
            --title "llama-connect ${{ steps.version.outputs.build }} (v${{ steps.version.outputs.version }})" \
            --generate-notes

name: build

on:
  push:
    branches: [master, main]
  pull_request:
  workflow_dispatch:
  workflow_call:

jobs:
  build:
    name: ${{ matrix.name }}
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.os }}
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        include:
          - name: macos-arm64
            os: macos-14
            target: aarch64-apple-darwin
          # macos-x64 disabled: no Intel macOS runners available on GH
          # - name: macos-x64
          #   os: macos-13
          #   target: x86_64-apple-darwin
          - name: linux-x64
            os: ubuntu-22.04
            target: x86_64-unknown-linux-musl
          - name: linux-arm64
            os: ubuntu-22.04-arm
            target: aarch64-unknown-linux-musl
          - name: win-x64
            os: windows-2022
            target: x86_64-pc-windows-msvc
          # TODO: win-arm64 (aarch64-pc-windows-msvc, cross-compiled from windows-2022)
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Install musl toolchain
        if: contains(matrix.target, 'musl')
        run: sudo apt-get update && sudo apt-get install -y musl-tools

      - name: Add rust target
        run: rustup target add ${{ matrix.target }}

      - uses: Swatinem/rust-cache@v2
        with:
          key: ${{ matrix.target }}

      - name: Run tests
        run: cargo test --target ${{ matrix.target }}

      # in-process WebRTC smoke test; loopback-only ICE, no external network needed
      - name: Loopback smoke test
        run: cargo run --release --example loopback --target ${{ matrix.target }}
        env:
          LSC_LOOPBACK_ICE: 1

      - name: Build
        run: cargo build --release --bin llama-connect --target ${{ matrix.target }}

      - name: Package
        shell: bash
        run: |
          mkdir -p dist
          cd target/${{ matrix.target }}/release
          if [[ "${{ matrix.name }}" == win-* ]]; then
            7z a ../../../dist/llama-connect-${{ matrix.name }}.zip llama-connect.exe
          else
            tar czf ../../../dist/llama-connect-${{ matrix.name }}.tar.gz llama-connect
          fi

      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: llama-connect-${{ matrix.name }}
          path: dist/*
          if-no-files-found: error

[package]
name = "llama-server-connect"
version = "0.0.1"
edition = "2024"

[[bin]]
name = "llama-connect"
path = "src/main.rs"

[profile.release]
lto = true
codegen-units = 1
strip = "symbols"

[dependencies]
base64 = "0.22"
env_logger = "0.11.11"
futures-util = "0.3.34"
log = { version = "0.4.33", features = ["std"] }
rand = "0.8"
reqwest = { version = "0.13.4", default-features = false, features = ["stream"] }
serde = { version = "1.0.229", features = ["derive"] }
serde_json = "1.0.151"
tokio = { version = "1.53.1", features = ["rt-multi-thread", "macros", "time", "net", "sync", "io-util"] }
tokio-tungstenite = { version = "0.30.0", features = ["rustls-tls-webpki-roots"] }
webrtc = "0.17"

[dev-dependencies]
env_logger = "0.11.11"

# llama-connect

Allow web UI to connect to a locally-hosted `llama-server` instance via WebRTC peer-to-peer connection.

Frontend protocol: https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/24577

## Demo

```sh
# for example, llama-server is running on port 8080

llama-connect --port 8080
```

Then open [client.html](examples/client.html) demo to connect to it. The chat completion request will be proxied to local `llama-server` via WebRTC connection.

#!/usr/bin/env bash
#
# Regenerates THIRD_PARTY_LICENSES.txt from the crate dependency graph.
#
# Run this after adding, removing or upgrading a dependency, and commit the
# resulting THIRD_PARTY_LICENSES.txt alongside the Cargo.lock change.
set -euo pipefail

cd "$(dirname "$0")"

if ! cargo about --version >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    echo "cargo-about is not installed. Install it with:" >&2
    echo "    cargo install cargo-about --locked --features cli" >&2
    exit 1
fi

# --fail turns an unlicensed or unaccepted crate into an error rather than a
# silent omission from the notices.
cargo about generate --fail -c about.toml -o THIRD_PARTY_LICENSES.txt about.hbs

echo "Wrote THIRD_PARTY_LICENSES.txt"

# Configuration for cargo-about, used by generate_thrid_party_licenses.sh
#
# `accepted` is an ordered preference list: for a crate offering a choice of
# licenses (e.g. "MIT OR Apache-2.0"), the first entry that matches is the one
# reproduced in THIRD_PARTY_LICENSES.txt. MIT is listed first to keep the output
# to a single short notice for the ~200 crates that offer it.
accepted = [
    "MIT",
    "Apache-2.0",
    "Apache-2.0 WITH LLVM-exception",
    "BSD-1-Clause",
    "BSD-2-Clause",
    "BSD-3-Clause",
    "ISC",
    "Zlib",
    "Unlicense",
    "Unicode-3.0",
    "CDLA-Permissive-2.0",
]

# Only crates reachable for these targets are included; this drops
# platform-specific dependencies that never ship in our binaries.
targets = [
    "x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu",
    "aarch64-unknown-linux-gnu",
    "aarch64-apple-darwin",
    "x86_64-pc-windows-msvc",
]

# Build-only and test-only dependencies are not distributed.
ignore-build-dependencies = true
ignore-dev-dependencies = true
